rationale: Added a distinct digest-pinned --opencode-host-image input, exported OMNIGENT_OPENCODE_HOST_IMAGE_REF for the run, gave each combination a code-owned host_image_key, and required every claimed combination to publish hostImageRef equal to that pinned images entry.

Cleanup expectations are now derived from the launch policy cleanup mode: remove requires live_host_stopped with liveResourcesRemoved true, drain requires live_host_drained with liveResourcesRemoved false, at both the cleanupReceipt and manifest cleanupOutcome gates.
The cleanup receipt now compares the ordered step list directly against the combination's required step tuple instead of comparing sets with a release-last check.

Report cases must now equal the code-owned workflow_chat_case_id set for the combination's four rows and reference exactly that row's evidence refs; passed must equal the row count and skipped must be zero.
action() takes a log_id and the workflow_chat controller passes the combination id, so each combination retains its own workflow_chat-<row>-<combination>.log.

providerProfileClass is now pinned by the claimed combination inventory (with the credential materializer ref required in bindingIdentity.materializerRefs), so evidence collected under one credential/provider authority class cannot qualify another.
executionCreation is cross-checked against the matching browser trace event's method and normalized path before created_through_public_executions_api is derived.
Denied capability enforcement observations are propagated into expected_denial_statuses, and the unit fixture now uses an independent enforcement request id instead of reusing one from denialAudit.
Informational Codex review summary body; no action requested.

_write_workflow_chat_report takes an auth_mode; each per-combination report publishes the combination's code-owned auth mode (validated against the manifest) and the aggregate report names every mode it exercised.

cross_user and cross_workflow denials must record authorized/attempted user and workflow identities, bind the authorized workflow to the session under test, and vary exactly the scope they claim to isolate.
